==Opening Words==

==Closing Hymn==
:How sweet the living water from the hills of Life,
:It makes us glad and happy all the way;
:
Now glory, grace and blessing mark the path I tread,
:We're "Bringing Life" with water every day.

:Drinking at the spring of living water, happy now am I, my soul is satisfied!
:Drinking at the spring of living water, a wonderful and bountiful supply!
